## HA/DR audit 2026-10-23: independent readback after closure, follow-ups moved to VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#1076

**Disposition: completed, for the placement and planned-relocation scope of this issue.** The audit item PCR-06 (absorbing XC-17) asked for the same change: deploy #1066 and qualify relocation off node7. The audit re-checked live state after this issue closed:

- **[V 2026-10-23T20:22:56Z]** `verdify-prod-dark` is Synced / Healthy at `3b2516fe`, and `0bcaddfe` (#1066) is an ancestor of that revision.
- **[V 20:22:56Z]** verdify-db, verdify-grafana and verdify-hermes-iris select on `kubernetes.io/os=linux`, `agentfleet.vallery.net/node-class=general` and `storage.vallery.net/longhorn-attach=true` only. No Deployment or StatefulSet in `verdify-prod` has a `kubernetes.io/hostname` nodeSelector.
- **[V 20:22:56Z]** All three workloads run on node5 (verdify-db-0 Ready, 0 restarts).
- **[V 20:22:56Z]** The Longhorn volumes are attached and healthy:
  - db-data: R3 on node4, node7 and node8
  - grafana: R2 on node4 and node8
  - hermes: R2 on node4 and node5
- **[V 20:22:56Z]** Events show Multi-Attach and attach retries for the DB, Grafana and Hermes claims at 19:25-19:30Z. They cleared within the measured 43.9 s DB read-recovery interval in the receipt above, and Hermes recovered later after its cold image pull. That is consistent with an orderly RWO detach and reattach.

The audit confirms the residual boundaries this issue already lists:

- Eligibility is exactly two workers, node4 and node5, on different physical hosts.
- Unplanned loss of the active host still leaves the single RWO writer operator-bound. That is tracked in jvallery/storage-infra#714 (fenced release).
- Automatic recovery within a tier target would need a replicated database design. That depends on the tier ratification in fleet control-plane fleet control-plane #5378. #245 stays closed as not planned.

The follow-ups that remain are tracked in VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#1076. They are outside this issue's acceptance:

- `verdify-lab-cache-origin` still rolls out with `maxSurge: 1` on its RWO claim. Its self-affinity prevents Multi-Attach in ordinary rollouts, but the rollout stalls when the origin's node is cordoned.
- There is no stuck-scheduling or ProgressDeadlineExceeded alert for `verdify-prod`.
- The placement analysis needs a rerun, and the host-loss boundaries need to go into the runbook and `OWNERSHIP.md`.

No reopen is needed.

Audit references: HA/DR audit 2026-10-23, item PCR-06 (findings WP-03, WP-11, O-02), with a live re-check at 20:22-20:25Z.
